Colour Type Components

Oku, measured

Values come from computed styles and the --theme-ui-colors-* custom properties on oku.club, read live on 2026-11-19. The header toggle sets data-mode. Oku itself follows prefers-color-scheme and paints dark when that media query is dark. Fabric Serif is not loaded here, and no web font is fetched: Source Serif 4 (or Georgia) stands in for the display face, and Inter shows only where it is installed.

The preview browser did not produce screenshot frames, so this package has no screenshots or crops.
